verdict.rationale: The README states that the skill uses the open Agent Skills format (a folder with a SKILL.md) and works in any agent that supports skills. It also describes installing by copying the skill folder into a skills directory, with the agent picking the skill up from its description. Missing for 10: evidence of SKILL.md frontmatter or spec conformance details, a demonstration or independent report of the folder working in a non-Claude agent, and clarity on whether the Python tools and plugin marketplace packaging stay portable.
